71001.name: The Midwinter Gala
71001.summary: Guests do not use ally slots. Skull: minus the agenda number (one worse on hard/expert). Cultist: minus Guests here, capped at 5; on hard/expert count story assets instead. Tablet: -2, or -4 in a Private room (-3/-5 on hard/expert). Elder Thing: -3 (-4 on hard/expert); take 1 horror if you fail or the Bloodless Man is here, only once.

71002.name: Masked Revelers
71002.summary: Lantern Club enemies cannot take damage. Single-sided Guests leaving play become spellbound instead; Leaders are removed.
71002.backSummary: Shuffle the set-aside Monsters, both Vicious Ambush cards and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Continue with Unexpected Guests.

71003.name: Unexpected Guests
71003.summary: Single-sided Guests leaving play become spellbound instead; Leaders are removed.
71003.backSummary: If the silent Bloodless Man is in play, flip him to Unleashed. Otherwise each investigator may heal 1 horror from an investigator or Guest at their location.

71004.name: A Killer Party
71004.summary: Single-sided Guests leaving play become spellbound instead; Leaders are removed.
71004.backSummary: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. Proceed to the no-resolution ending and final scoring.

71005.name: Meet and Greet
71005.summary: Parley with a Guest here that you do not control: test one of its printed skills (3) to take control. An action can give your Guest to another investigator here. Spend 3 clues per investigator to advance only during agenda 2 or 3 and while each remaining investigator controls a Guest.
71005.backSummary: Put the three second-floor rooms into play in random order, connect the leftmost to the Lobby, resolve the Rival story and read the allied faction's Jewel interlude. Advance to Finding the Jewel.

71006.name: Finding the Jewel
71006.summary: Parley with Guests as before. Your allied story gives the conditions for completing the objective at the end of the round.
71006.backSummary: Proceed to resolution 1, your allied faction's resolution, then resolution 7 for scoring and experience.

71007.name: Lobby
71007.summary: During agenda 2 or 3, spend 1 resource per investigator to place the top Guest here. Group limit once per round.
71007.backSummary: Starting location. Ground-floor Manor connected to the ground-floor rooms and Lantern Chamber; the act later connects it to the leftmost second-floor room.

71008.name: Lantern Chamber
71008.summary: During your turn, name an encounter card and discover 1 clue here, then discard the top encounter card if guessed correctly, or draw it otherwise. Once per turn. With no clues here, an action tests willpower (4) to turn a spellbound card faceup.
71008.backSummary: Private basement Manor. Entering while unrevealed costs 1 horror; later entries do not pay it again.

71009.name: Art Gallery
71009.summary: Action: place 2 clues from the pool here and gain 2 resources. Group limit once per round.
71009.backSummary: Unrevealed ground-floor Manor room. Reveal it on entry.

71010.name: Ballroom
71010.summary: Parley: exhaust two ready Guests here, then heal 1 horror from each. Choose the Guests; with only one available, exhaust it without healing.
71010.backSummary: Unrevealed ground-floor Manor room. Reveal it on entry.

71011.name: Barroom
71011.summary: Spend 1 resource to heal 1 damage or horror from an investigator or Guest here. Group limit once per round.
71011.backSummary: Unrevealed ground-floor Manor room. Reveal it on entry.

71012.name: Bedroom
71012.summary: Action, once per turn: fight an enemy in any second-floor room using combat or agility. After success, you may spend 1 clue for 2 additional damage.
71012.backSummary: Unrevealed second-floor Manor room. It enters play after the first act advances.

71013.name: Library
71013.summary: Gain +1 skill while parleying here. If the Jewel is here, test intellect (3) to place 1 damage on it or remove 1 damage/doom. Group limit once per game.
71013.backSummary: Unrevealed second-floor Manor room. It enters play after the first act advances.

71014.name: Parlor
71014.summary: Shroud is reduced by Guests here, to a minimum of 1. If you control the Jewel, exhaust a ready enemy anywhere. Group limit once per game.
71014.backSummary: Unrevealed second-floor Manor room. It enters play after the first act advances.

71015.name: The Foundation
71015.summary: If the Jewel is here and the Bloodless Man is out of play, an action takes the Jewel and places 1 damage on it. At round end, control the Jewel and spend 2 clues per investigator to finish. Faction score: 4 points with no non-weakness enemies in play, 2 with one, otherwise 0.
71015.backSummary: Rival: shuffle Rookie Cop into the encounter deck and spawn rival Valeriya at the lead investigator. Parley combat (3), placing 1 of your clues here on success. With 1 clue per investigator, place the story and rival Leader in victory and remove their Rival card.

71016.name: Valeriya Antonova
71016.summary: +1 combat. Action, exhaust: ready another Guest here and gain a bonus to your next test this round equal to Guests here. A Leader leaving play is removed.
71016.backSummary: Cannot take damage. Aloof, Hunter. Your skills are reduced by 1 here if you control an exhausted Guest. At round end exhaust Guests here. The Rival story provides a combat (3) parley.

71017.name: Archibald Hudson
71017.summary: During your turn exhaust to search the top 9 encounter cards for an enemy; draw it, shuffle, exhaust it and gain 3 resources. Action, spend 1 resource: move 1 damage from an asset here to a non-Elite enemy here.

71018.name: Special Agent Callahan
71018.summary: Action: fight with the enemy's fight reduced by 1. After you use an Ally or Weapon action ability, exhaust Callahan to deal 1 damage to an enemy here.

71019.name: Horacio Martinez
71019.summary: May receive damage for other investigators here. After a non-Elite enemy attacks you, exhaust Horacio to exhaust that enemy and prevent it readying this round.

71020.name: Rookie Cop
71020.summary: Surge, Aloof, Hunter. After an investigator here attacks another enemy, deal 1 damage to that investigator.

71021.name: Miskatonic University
71021.summary: Parley with Declan here: place 1 or 2 of your clues on him. At 3 clues per investigator, take his Jewel and place him in victory; he is immune to damage while holding it. At round end, controlling the Jewel completes the objective. Score 1 point per 2 cards per investigator in the group's hands, maximum 4.
71021.backSummary: Rival: shuffle Confusion into the encounter deck and spawn rival Caldwell at the lead investigator. Parley intellect (3), placing 1 of your clues here on success. At 1 clue per investigator, defeat the Rival story and remove its Rival card.

71022.name: Caldwell Philips
71022.summary: +1 intellect. After you discover clues, exhaust to draw that many cards, maximum 3. A Leader leaving play is removed.
71022.backSummary: Cannot take damage. Aloof, Hunter. An investigator ending their turn here discards 1 non-weakness card. The Rival story provides an intellect (3) parley.

71023.name: Dr. Mya Badry
71023.summary: +2 hand size. Action, exhaust: investigate with base intellect equal to the number of cards in your hand.

71024.name: Lucas Tetlow
71024.summary: After the last clue here is discovered, exhaust to search the top 9 cards of your deck for an Item asset and draw it. Relic: gain 2 resources. Tome: you may play it, paying its cost, without an action. Tool: discover 1 clue at a connected location.

71025.name: Elizabeth Conrad
71025.summary: After you draw a card during your turn, exhaust: an investigator here may move to a connected location.

71026.name: Confusion
71026.summary: Surge. Place 2 of your clues at your location. Take 1 horror for each clue you cannot place.

71027.name: The Syndicate
71027.summary: Action, spend 1 clue per investigator: look at mysteries under your location. During your turn you may draw a mystery under a revealed location with at most 1 clue per investigator. At round end control the Jewel in the Lobby and spend 4 clues per investigator to finish. Score 1 point per 3 resources per investigator, maximum 4.
71027.backSummary: Rival: shuffle Cold Streak into the encounter deck and spawn rival Johnny at the lead investigator. Parley agility (3), placing 1 of your clues here on success. At 1 clue per investigator, defeat the Rival story and remove its Rival card.

71028.name: Johnny Valone
71028.summary: +1 agility. After gaining resources from an effect, exhaust to draw 1 card and gain 1 resource. A Leader leaving play is removed.
71028.backSummary: Cannot take damage. Aloof, Hunter. An investigator ending their turn here loses 2 resources. The Rival story provides an agility (3) parley.

71029.name: Miranda Keeper
71029.summary: 3 supplies. Spend 1 supply to place an antiquity here and gain +2 to your next test this round. After succeeding by 2 or more, remove an antiquity here to gain 2 resources.

71030.name: Arsène Renard
71030.summary: Once per game as a group, place an antiquity at each location. With an exhausted enemy here, remove an antiquity here to draw 1 card or gain 2 resources.

71031.name: Nova Malone
71031.summary: Action, exhaust: fight with base combat equal to your resources (maximum 7) and +1 damage. After defeating an enemy, gain 1 resource, once per round.

71032.name: Cold Streak
71032.summary: Surge. Lose 4 resources; for each missing resource, choose 1 damage or 1 horror.

71033.name: Silver Twilight Lodge
71033.summary: Action, twice per round as a group: discard the top encounter card; you may draw it. At round end control the Jewel and spend 5 clues per investigator to finish. Score 1 point per treachery without victory points in victory, maximum 4.
71033.backSummary: Rival: shuffle Ward of Preservation into the encounter deck and spawn rival Carl at the lead investigator. Parley willpower (3), placing 1 of your clues here on success. At 1 clue per investigator, defeat the Rival story and remove its Rival card.

71034.name: Carl Sanford
71034.summary: +1 willpower and an extra arcane slot. After a non-weakness treachery's effect is cancelled, exhaust to place that treachery in victory and draw 1 card. A Leader leaving play is removed.
71034.backSummary: Cannot take damage. Aloof, Hunter. Investigators here have -1 willpower. The Rival story provides a willpower (3) parley.

71035.name: Prudence Douglas
71035.summary: 3 portents. During your turn, exhaust and spend 1 portent: look at the top 4 encounter cards, discard up to 2 non-Elite cards and put the others back in any order.

71036.name: Sarah Van Shaw
71036.summary: Action, exhaust and spend up to 2 resources: fight adding your willpower to combat, with +1 damage per resource spent.

71037.name: Raymond Loggins
71037.summary: 4 truths. When you draw a non-weakness treachery, spend 1 truth to cancel its revelation, discard it and take 1 horror.

71038.name: Ward of Preservation
71038.summary: Surge. Put in your threat area. When you play an event, cancel its effects, take 1 horror and discard this treachery.

71039.name: Locals of Kingsport
71039.summary: Action, combat or agility (3): remove 1 damage or doom from the Jewel placed here; you may take it. At round end control the token-free Jewel and spend 3 clues per investigator to finish. Score 4 minus the number of cards in the Guest deck, minimum 0.
71039.backSummary: Rival: shuffle Unlucky into the encounter deck and spawn rival William at the lead investigator. Parley with any skill (4), placing 1 of your clues here on success. At 1 clue per investigator, defeat the Rival story and remove its Rival card.

71040.name: William Bain
71040.summary: +1 to your skills while cards are committed to your test. After you commit a card, exhaust and spend 1 resource per investigator to place the top Guest in the Lobby. A Leader leaving play is removed.
71040.backSummary: Cannot take damage. Aloof, Hunter. Investigators here cannot commit cards to tests. The Rival story provides a parley using any skill (4).

71041.name: Delores Gadling
71041.summary: Humanoid enemies do not make opportunity attacks against you. While investigating or parleying with intellect, gain +1 intellect per Humanoid enemy here.

71042.name: Thomas Olney
71042.summary: Exhaust and name a trait: discard the top encounter card and gain 2 resources if it has that trait. During a test here, exhaust to discard the top card of your deck and commit it if eligible, respecting assistance restrictions.

71043.name: Claire Wilson
71043.summary: After you commit a card to your own test, exhaust to gain +1 to that test.

71044.name: Unlucky
71044.summary: Surge. Put in your threat area: -2 to your skills. Discard at round end.

71045.name: The Bloodless Man
71045.summary: Silent Lurker: Aloof; patrols towards Guests. If ready at investigation phase end, deal 1 horror to investigators and Guests here; with the Lantern attached, those Guests become spellbound. Instead of defeat, flip, exhaust and retain at most 3 damage per investigator.
71045.backSummary: Hunter, Massive. After attacking an investigator, remove a Guest they control from the game. Victory 1.

71046.name: The Pale Lantern
71046.summary: Hypnotic Glow: if the Bloodless Man has damage or is in victory, test combat or agility (3) to take the Lantern and flip it.
71046.backSummary: Action: turn a spellbound card here faceup. Action, exhaust: test combat or agility (2) to place 1 damage on the Lantern. At 3 damage place it in victory and turn all spellbound cards faceup. Leaving play returns its Glow side to your location.

71047.name: Enraged Gug
71047.summary: Alert, Hunter. Horror from its attacks must be assigned to Guests first, while they have capacity.

71048.name: Abhorrent Moon-Beast
71048.summary: Hunter, Retaliate. Damage from its attacks must be assigned to Guests first, while they have capacity.

71049.name: Savage Shantak
71049.summary: Hunter. +1 fight and evade for each Guest at its location.

71050.name: Vicious Ambush
71050.summary: With no Monster in play, gain surge. Otherwise the nearest Monster readies, moves to you along connections, engages and attacks. Choose tied Monsters and shortest paths.

71051.name: Declan Pearce
71051.summary: Hunter; 2 health plus 2 per investigator. You have one fewer action while engaged with him. If ready at enemy phase end, heal 1 damage from each enemy.

71052.name: Jewel of Sarnath
71052.summary: Revelation: take control with 3 damage and 1 doom. Exhaust, test willpower or agility (1): move 1 of its damage/doom to an enemy here. When leaving play, shuffle it into the encounter deck.

71053.name: Lantern Club Member
71053.summary: During agenda 1, parley and spend 1 resource to automatically evade it, or 3 resources to discard it. Lantern Club immunity applies during agenda 1.

71054.name: Bleeding Walls
71054.summary: Test willpower against your location's shroud. On failure, lose 1 action and take 1 horror.

71055.name: Entrap
71055.summary: Test agility (3). On failure, if the Bloodless Man is here spellbind one of your Guests; if elsewhere he moves to you; if absent gain surge.

71056.name: Inexplicable Cold
71056.summary: Test agility (4). For each point of failure choose to discard an asset in play, discard a card from hand, or take 1 damage.

71057.name: Mind Extraction
71057.summary: Test willpower against 1 plus the agenda number. On failure take 2 horror. Afterwards, if the Bloodless Man is in play and an investigator controls the Lantern, reattach it to him.

71058.name: Noxious Fumes
71058.summary: Each investigator here chooses agility (3), moving to a connected location on success or taking 2 damage on failure; or combat (3), taking 1 damage per point of failure.

71059.name: Pushed into the Beyond
71059.summary: Shuffle one of your non-story, non-permanent assets into your deck, then discard its top 3 cards. If a copy is discarded, take 2 horror.

71060.name: Secret Door
71060.summary: Attach to a Manor with the most investigators and no Secret Door, choosing ties. Investigators cannot leave. Action, test willpower or intellect (3) to discard it.

71061.name: Terror Gate
71061.summary: Test willpower (2), +2 difficulty with a Rival enemy in play. On failure: Foundation takes 2 damage; Miskatonic discards 2 cards; Syndicate loses 3 resources; Lodge takes 2 horror; Kingsport loses 1 action.

71062.name: Violent Commands
71062.summary: Put in your threat area. At your turn's end, test willpower (3), taking 1 horror on failure. An investigator here may use an action to deal 2 damage to an investigator here and discard this treachery.
